exposure: screening for retinopathy of prematurity (ROP) with mydriatic eyedrops (0.5% phenylephrine and 0.5% tropicamide)
cohort: The study included 86 consecutive infants who underwent screening for retinopathy of prematurity (ROP) with mydriatic eyedrops.
finding: Screening for ROP with mydriatic was associated with an increase in abdominal distention, reduced milk consumption, and decreased pulse rates in infants after examination.
